description: Day 5 end-to-end UI scenarios. mock_reply is a recorded live model reply, replayed offline (source=mock).

scenarios.scenario: Generate 12 subscription payments: 8 successful and 4 failed. Each payment must have a valid invoice, subscription, and customer. Every failed invoice must remain unpaid, and every successful invoice must be paid.
scenarios.mock_reply_source: Recorded verbatim from the live Gemini run on 2026-11-11 (prompt P04, gemini-3.5-flash-lite) through the Streamlit app; see reports/day5/ui_e2e_payment_live.txt.

assumptions: Generated 12 total payments split into 8 successful and 4 failed.
Ensured each payment maps to an invoice, subscription, and customer.
